We need to use the Gorilla file system tools. Steps:

It says: "Destination must be local to the current directory and cannot be a path. If destination is not an existing directory like when renaming something, destination is the new file name." But cp also cannot specify path? It says: "If the destination is a directory, the source file or directory will be copied into the destination directory. Both source and destination must be local to the current directory." So cp can copy into a directory. So we can cp final_report.pdf temp. Then rm final_report.pdf. That would effectively move.
